01 — The Method

Every session works
to a drawing.

A padel game is a build. It goes up in order — foundations first — and every Blueprint session trains one layer deliberately, so improvement compounds instead of plateauing.

01

Footwork

The split step, recovery and court movement — the base layer every shot is built on.

02

Positioning

Where to stand, when to press, and how to read the ball off the glass before it arrives.

03

Repetition

Deliberate, corrected reps — technique drilled until it holds when the point gets fast.

04

Match craft

Shot selection, patterns and pressure play — turning clean technique into won points.

03 — The Coach
"Two years ago I took a step back. Not because I was done — because I was building something new."

Blueprint Padel Academy is Coach Hasan's answer to coaching that just fills an hour. Every player — first-timer to competitor, junior to veteran — trains to a plan, gets corrected, and leaves with something to work on.

03b — Why it holds up

Structure, not hours.

FACT.01

One coach, one venue

Every session is run personally by Coach Hasan at Arturf Padel Arena — not handed to a rotating roster.

FACT.02

Groups capped at four

Academy sessions never exceed four players, matched by ability, so nobody trains unseen.

FACT.03

Placement before payment

Every new player starts with a free on-court assessment, so they're placed at the right level from day one.

FACT.04

Same method, every format

Private lessons and Academy groups run the same four-stage curriculum — footwork, positioning, repetition, match craft.

04 — Standards

House rules.

STD.01

Discipline

Show up, do the reps, trust the process — progress is built, not found.

STD.02

Respect

For partners, opponents, the coach and the court. Every session, every point.

STD.03

Humility

Every player has something to fix. The best ones want to hear what it is.

STD.04

Community

Padel is a doubles game. We train better partners — on and off the court.
